title: Geechee Robinson's trombone style and Louis Armstrong's influence
summary: Geechee played Tricky Sam style but his own solos; Armstrong influenced everyone and Albert dedicated his concert set to Louis.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
